description: Diagnostic, making no recipe change. It replaces I025, which pointed at E015, and answers the main crux of W1, W2, W3 and W5: is E016's 0.7607 real margin or a reshuffle? (1) Run the committed E016 recipe offline on held-out seeds 3-12 through the harness code path (benchmark.run --seed 3 --n 10). Record per-seed accuracy, the 10-seed mean, the std and the offset from 0.7607. (2) Secondary, for H4.3.1: clear the inductor cache and rebuild E016 in a fresh process, run seeds 0-2 again, and record whether the per-seed accuracies are bit-identical and how far the 3-seed mean shifts. (3) While doing this, read the true optimizer step count from the code for H4.2.3. E012's per-epoch timing listed 10 epoch loops, the last about half length, which suggests about 9.5 true epochs. Do not edit submissions/arena/.
